Your band combines optical pulse and oxygen estimates, wrist movement, skin temperature, ambient temperature/humidity and a gas-based air-quality category. Pulse variability, activity and sleep/wake patterns can be derived from these signals. Insights also offers experimental pulse-based sleep stages and a profile/activity-based VO₂ max estimate. Those estimates are not direct band measurements or validated results for this device.

Autonomic Load compares pulse variability and heart rate during still periods with your own usual range. A higher result can have several causes, including recent exertion, poor sleep or heat. It is an experimental wellness indicator, not a diagnosis or a measurement of emotional stress. See Insights for the current result.

Wear the band snugly without discomfort, keep the optical window clean, and sit still for a resting reading. Check fit if readings drop out. Movement, poor contact and cold skin can reduce signal quality; missing readings shouldn't be treated as normal values.
